reason: Our agent volume is tiny today, and what the examiner asked was how we use AI in general, not how we govern customer agents trading. I can answer that with a policy memo and our existing controls, so I'm not putting a new proxy in the trade path this quarter.
objection: A startup with no customers and no SOC 2 sitting in front of every trade and payment is a third-party risk problem I'd have to defend to the next examiner. Our vendor review won't pass it, and a free pilot still means signing an LOI with a price on it.
would_change_my_mind: A regulator or examiner specifically asking us to show agent-level authorization and kill-switch evidence, together with a finished SOC 2 Type II and a peer broker I can call as a reference.
